discovery_notes: 32 WebSearch queries, all search_snippet. Mostly Mousesteps monthly schedules (pre-release). Halloween 2025 OE/LE and Brother Bear from mypincentral Sept 2025 flyer (summary did not distinguish Sept vs Oct flyer URLs; Sept chosen as it covers Sept 20). Music Festival May 3 and muguet second list attributed to Disney Mouseketeer per summary wording; attribution moderate. Picsou 'three other pins' mapping to Scrooge/Donald/Beagle Boys is snippet wording. Pajama Party/skiing per-character pins may be combined designs. No prompt-injection seen.
